I have verified the relevant source. Here are my findings.

FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#tokenize","claim":"tokenize lowercases, splits on non-[a-z0-9_], drops tokens of length <=2 and a STOP set, and is exported so the RAG ranker/expander tokenize identically to getLessons/recall","evidence":"src/db.mjs:224"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#idfRank","claim":"idfRank is a shared IDF-weighted lexical ranker: score = sum of idf(t) for query tokens present in the doc, idf(t)=log(1+N/df(t)), keeps score>0, sorts desc, caps at limit, with a tieBreak callback","evidence":"src/db.mjs:229-238"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#getLessons","claim":"getLessons ranks non-pass attempts across plans by IDF lexical match of terms (or a step's title+tools) against step_title+what_tried+result, excluding the step's own attempts and scoping to the current project unless all=true","evidence":"src/db.mjs:763-787"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#getLessons","claim":"getLessons tie-breaks equal scores by created_at descending (newest first) via (a,b)=>(a.created_at<b.created_at?1:-1)","evidence":"src/db.mjs:780"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recall","claim":"recall builds docs from plans, steps, attempts, and active findings, tokenizes each doc's text, and ranks with the same idfRank, returning type/id/plan_id/step_id/title/status/snippet/score","evidence":"src/db.mjs:1071-1101"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recall","claim":"recall only includes findings with status='active' (superseded/retracted never resurface) and marks a finding 'conflict' when conflicts_with is non-empty","evidence":"src/db.mjs:1087-1090"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#currentProjectId","claim":"currentProjectId reads settings key 'current_project' and defaults to 1; recall/getLessons scope to this project unless all=true","evidence":"src/db.mjs:417-420"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recall","claim":"recall returns {query, hits:[]} immediately when the tokenized query is empty, and scores are rounded to 2 decimals","evidence":"src/db.mjs:1072-1073,1098"}]VERDICT: pass — investigated Store.recall and Store.getLessons in src/db.mjs: both use the shared exported tokenize + idfRank IDF-weighted lexical ranker, with project scoping, attempt/step exclusion, and active-only finding recall verified in source.
